items.name: Enghumleblom
items.observations: Review of the exact WebP confirms drooping reddish-purple hairy calyces, pale peach-pink petals, hairy reddish flowering stems and interruptedly pinnate basal leaves. The larger terminal leaflets are lobed and toothed and smaller lateral leaflets are present. Multiple blooms and buds are shown.
items.limitations: Petals are more pink and saturated than in many wild examples, flowers are enlarged for legibility, foliage is more symmetrical than typical specimens, and roots are illustrative. This is a field-guide illustration, not conclusive botanical identification.
